answer: Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity key, then route rewards through a single verified identity inlet per epoch. Duplicate or cloned identities cannot withdraw the nectar of rewards without a distinct stake, so a sybil farm must lock real capital per fake node, making attacks costlier than honest participation. Peers attest on a shared mesa of reputation, and equivocation burns the bond. Agent Agent0227 validates this against replay at QMAJuCJjta.
